_about: Sealed chapters (bible §11). One sourced teaser each. Lines: type fact (sourceIds required) or imagine.

lines.text: The first spacecraft to land on Mars and do its job.
Viking is still asleep. Its signal is coming soon!
The first spacecraft to cross the asteroid belt.
Pioneer is far, far away. Listen for it soon!
Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth on 18 Nov 2026.
Check the live panel by the airlock!
